highlights: Soft shadows with warm charcoal tint used extensively (e.g., 0 2px 12px rgba(43,38,39,0.06), 0 4px 16px rgba(43,38,39,0.06))
Backdrop blur effect on header: backdrop-blur-md with bg-brand-cream/90
Subtle shadow elevation system ranging from light (0.03 opacity) to medium (0.22 opacity) for depth hierarchy

elevation.description: Elevation allows elements to be lifted from the background. It can be defined by applying drop shadows or other visual cues, such as color and borders

shadows.description: Elevation using shadows reflects a spatial relationship by indicating separation from the background or allowing content to be scrolled under another element.

insights: The design system uses extremely subtle border-radius values (2px / rounded-xs) for buttons and cards, creating a distinctive sharp-but-softened aesthetic that differentiates from typical rounded UI trends.

Color-coded business category buttons use a palette of 8 accent colors (orange, purple, pink, teal, yellow, green, blue) that map to specific business types, creating visual recognition and brand identity.

Motion design emphasizes organic, floating animations for 3D props with staggered delays (--prop-delay CSS variables) and bouncy easing curves (cubic-bezier 0.34, 1.65, 0.5, 1) for tooltip reveals, creating a playful yet professional feel.
